notes_for_editor: Brief's access value of 'permission' is not supported by the NHLR page or the other pages read, so no access key was written rather than guessing. Brief's agency field repeats the NHLR 'Administered by' value, which is a reservation rather than an agency; BIA is the listed cooperator. Brief's elevation of 2690.5 m matches NHLR's 2,690 m. Single substantive source. A NOAA tree-ring fire dataset titled 'Guiterman fire data from Tohatchi Lookout' turned up in search but was not read and is not used. Fact-check 2026-10-08: added the McKinley County and cooperator evidence the story cites; the BIA advice in the story now rests on the register's cooperator line.
